Applicants having a current certificate of qualification from the Ohio Construction Industry Examining Board or registration from any other State Certified Building Department may be issued the same type of registration upon a submittal of photocopies of the certificates or registrations . 2. If you are registering as a HVAC, PLUMBING OR ELECTRICAL contractor, a copy of your current state license is required. 3. The application fee is $100.00 per category . Make the check payable to the City of Willoughby. 4. If registering as a Fire Protection Contractor, a copy of your current Fire Marshal’s Certificate is REQUIRED . 5.
